textRuns.value: Above a high threshold, fire sizes follow a generalised Pareto tail. Its shape says how slowly the chance of a bigger fire fades: above 0.5 the variance is infinite, at 1 or more even the mean is. Each country is fitted on EFFIS fires of 30 ha or more, 2016 to 2025, complete years only. A return level is published only within twice the observed period, so no 50-year figure appears. Click a country in the bar chart to draw its curve.
